title: LGSCO decision 15 017 863 · Adult care services — Assessment and care plan (Upheld)
text:
Category :
Adult care services
>
Assessment and care plan
Decision :
Upheld
Decision date :
08 Feb 2017
Summary
A Solicitor complains the Council has failed to assess Ms K’s daughter’s finances properly by failing to disregard the daughter’s personal injury payment.
The complaint
The Solicitor complained because the Council failed to disregard the personal injury payment, the daughter was left with less support than she was entitled to.
Finding
The Ombudsman upheld the complaint and found fault causing injustice.
Recommendations
To remedy the injustice caused, the Council should backdate its payments to the date it accepted Ms K’s daughter had eligible care needs.
